name: kinetic-type-poster
title: A festival poster where the type moves
summary: A Swiss-style concert poster on one canvas: ECHO in huge letters that drop in one after another with an overshoot and then breathe, five red outline echoes trailing beneath them, a red disc beating inside a ring of text that turns, sound rings spreading past the edges, a sentence flowing along a moving sine wave, and a tilted black band with the dates scrolling. Light (warm paper), a designed dark look (night paper, cream type) and two still mono looks. About 4.2 KB.
prompt: Make a typographic poster that moves, like a concert poster: a big headline whose letters animate in one after another, text running along a curve that flows, a scrolling band with the dates, and a strong graphic design.
hand_built: Kinetic type is per-letter transforms and text on animated paths drawn on a canvas; no library component does this, and the whole poster is under 4 KB.
teaches: Per-letter animation: a loop over the word draws each letter, sliced out with textSubtext("ECHO", i, 1), its own drop (back-out easing 1 + 2.70158 p^3 + 1.70158 p^2 over 0.8 s, 0.14 s apart) and its own breathing scale about the baseline
Echoes: the same letters again in stroke style, five copies from the farthest to the nearest, each offset further down and fainter, the offsets swinging with sin(t)
Text on a circle that turns: a closed pathExpression circle and drawTextOnPath inside save { rotate(t * 14) about the centre }

Text flowing along a moving wave: a pathExpression whose y uses animationTime(), so the path itself moves, and an hOffset of -((t * 38) % width) from textMeasure, so the words slide along it seamlessly

The poster is laid out on a 360 x 640 sheet scaled to fit and centred; the paper, the rings, the wave and the tilted band run past the sheet to the screen edges, so a landscape tablet shows a wide composition, not a letterbox
The band: rotate -5 degrees about its centre, a black bar wider than the screen, and the dates repeated ceil(width / measured) + 1 times, moving by the measured width modulo

Two clocks: animationTime() (from 0 when the poster appears) for the one-off entrance, continuousSec() for everything that loops. A canvas that reads only animationTime() is not repainted by the players (the inspector reports repaint idle); continuousSec() schedules every frame

Four looks from one document: themed colours (paper, ink, red, ringLine, band, bandText) for light and dark, and {"$if": "theme.mono"} forks for the mono looks: the red becomes onSurface or muted, the filled disc an outlined ring, the band two rules, and the clocks are pinned (animationTime 4, continuousSec 0, a still wave) so an always-on screen does not repaint
pitfalls: Canvas text has no font weight in the JSON (paint has textSize and colour only): the headline is made heavy with fillAndStroke and a 3 px stroke
loop with a negative step does not run (from 5 until 0 step -1 drew nothing): count up and compute the reversed index
clamp is clamp(value, max, min) in these players

The TypeScript player draws the wave text off its curve at some frames (from about 4 s into the web render the words run nearly straight while drawPath of the same path still curves); the C++ player follows the wave at every time

A document whose motion reads only animationTime() is not repainted: drive looping motion from continuousSec() (or add wakeIn). It then repaints every frame for as long as it is shown — right for a poster or an idle screen, not for a widget

inputs.clock: animationTime drives the entrance (letters, echoes); continuousSec drives the loops (rings, disc, ring text, wave, band, breathing), which is also what keeps the poster repainting

the five echoes, a loop of loops

check.describe: Light, settled (t = 4 s): warm paper, grey concentric rings centred on a red disc at the top right, the disc inside a ring of small black text SOUND · LIGHT · MOTION · THREE NIGHTS · LISBOA · MMXXVI, N° 07 / LX FACTORY / LISBOA top left, ECHO in huge black letters across the middle with five red outline copies stepping down under it, a sentence (fourteen artists — three nights — one room full of noise) riding a sine wave, a two-line lineup, and a black band tilted up to the right with ECHO FESTIVAL 2026 — LISBON — 14 · 15 · 16 MAY in red. drop (t = 0.62 s): E and C landed or landing, H high up and O not yet in, no echoes yet. ring (t = 7.3 s): the ring text turned and the wave and band moved on. Landscape 1280x800: the sheet centred, rings, wave and band across the full width. Tablet portrait and a 300x300 square: the whole sheet scaled to fit. Dark: the same poster at night: near-black aubergine paper, cream type and ring text, faint lilac rings, the red disc and red echoes, a cream band with red dates. Mono dark and mono light: no red and no motion; the disc is an outlined record with a spindle hole, echoes in grey outline, the band two rules with the dates between, black on white or white on black.
